text:
Marta G: Heads upwe've got an external pentest (BlackLotus) focusing on KMS flows + auth. Proposed window: 2025-06-10 08:00-16:00 UTC. Need to lock down RBAC, KMS-proxy ACLs, and SIEM retention before then. @Sanjay R to own proxy mapping, @Jess L on SIEM/audit retention, @Ryan T triage cadence.

Sanjay R: I'll map ephemeral assessor role. Constraints: decrypt-only, no GenerateDataKey, no key creation, deny kms:Encrypt. Use kms-proxy with explicit audit fields. Draft policy snippet below.

Jess L: Strong +1 on deny for encrypt/generate. Also request we add an "x-pt-session" header required on all proxy calls so logs can be filtered and traced to the assessment id.

Marta G: We need immutable evidence storage for at least 14 days for the session artifacts and a redaction checklist for PII. Will also require PRs for each remediation with test vectors.

Ryan T: Triage SLA proposal: acknowledge within 8 hours; high/critical patch within 72 hours; medium within 10 days. Retest scheduling: hold weekly 2-hour slots the week after fixes. OpsBot will handle ephemeral cred issuance during the window.

OpsBot: action taken: create_ephemeral role=assessor-blacklotus-06010 ttl=6h issuer=@Marta G. SIEM index created: pt-blacklotus-20250610.

Sanjay R: Proxy config (draft):
```json
{
  "allowed_roles": ["assessor-blacklotus-06010"],
  "permissions": {"Decrypt": true, "Encrypt": false, "GenerateDataKey": false},
  "audit_fields": ["request_id","key_id","caller","x-pt-session"],
  "require_header": "x-pt-session",
  "rotate_token_minutes": 60
}
```
We will also wrap decrypt calls with an audit log entry that includes the PR id the assessor references.

Jess L: I'll request SIEM retention change: index pt-blacklotus-20250610 -> 120 days, immutable for 14 days post-window. Will create ticket INF-SIEM-786. Also adding a saved view for the x-pt-session header.

Marta G: Remediation/retest rules: must include a remediation PR, unit/regression test covering the vector, and an ops smoke-run (runbook steps) with log excerpts attached. Once QA passes, schedule retest slot.

Ryan T: Clarify severity handling: if exploitability is trivial and PoC exists -> critical, escalate to oncall and block deploys to affected envs until fix verified. Otherwise, follow SLA above. Also suggest a snapshot export of logs at end of day for chain-of-custody.

Sanjay R: PR opened: https://git.redwood.dev/infra/kms-proxy/pulls/427. Includes role template, proxy ACL, and test harness for audit emissions. Tagging @Jess L @Marta G for review.

Jess L: Ticket filed: INF-SIEM-786 link: https://tickets.redwood.dev/INF-SIEM-786. Added steps for immutability and retention.

Marta G: Good. Action items: Sanjay -> finish PR & test audit payloads; Jess -> complete SIEM changes and saved view; Ryan -> publish triage cadence + retest calendar and add blocklist rules for deploys if critical. We'll do dry-run Thurs 16:00 UTC to validate that audit entries include request_id, key_id, x-pt-session, and PR reference. :thumbsup: 

Sanjay R: Noted. Will include sample audit line in PR: `{"time":"...","request_id":"r_abc123","key_id":"alias/redwood-main","caller":"assessor-blacklotus-06010","x-pt-session":"BL-20250610-01","pr":"infra#427"}`

Jess L: I'll make sure the saved view filters on x-pt-session and request_id and dashboard exposes immutability status.

Ryan T: Putting weekly retest buckets on calendar: Mon/Wed/Fri 14:00-16:00 UTC during the following 2 weeks. Will notify product & infra leads.

Marta G: Thanks. We'll reconvene Fri 13:00 UTC for pre-window checklist and dry-run results.

OpsBot: reminder scheduled: dry-run-check Fri 2025-06-06 13:00 UTC.
